guide.name: The Guide
guide.description: A wise presence that shows the way when you are lost.

supporter.name: The Supporter
supporter.description: A strong pillar that silently protects your back and gives you strength.

connector.name: The Connector
connector.description: A bridge that connects you to new opportunities and people.

challenger.name: The Catalyst
challenger.description: A stimulant that grows you through good-willed competition.

title: Noble Persons
description: Precious connections that help you on your life's journey.
intro: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
finding: Look around. Your noble person might already be by your side.
